rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a police detective or investigator.

example.english: The detective is investigating the case now.
example.jyutping: taam3 jyun4 ji4 gaa1 caa4 gan2 on3

rows.note: Use this more official-sounding term when stressing that the detective investigates criminal cases.

example.english: The detective is responsible for investigating this murder case.
example.traditional: 刑警負責調查呢宗謀殺案。
example.jyutping: jing4 ging2 fu6 zaak3 diu6 caa4 ni1 zung1 mau4 saat3 on3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a private investigator hired to uncover information.

example.english: I hired a private detective to find out whether my husband was cheating.
example.traditional: 我請咗私家偵探查吓我老公有冇出軌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceng2 zo2 si1 gaa1 zing1 taam3 caa4 haa5 ngo5 lou5 gung1 jau5 mou5 ceot1 gwai2
